outputs.location: Section titled 'Data availability' (immediately following the Methods / Statistical analysis section)
outputs.issues: The DAS is not in the required bullet-point format. It only lists RNA-seq data deposited in BioStudies (S-BSST2081) but does not provide a resolvable link (identifiers.org or full URL) nor a DOI; the dataset entry lacks the exact formatted line: '[data type]: [repository] [accession/DOI] ([URL])'. Other data are described as 'available upon request' or 'source data included', which is acceptable but not broken out into clearly formatted bullet points. Please provide each deposited dataset as a separate bullet with measurement type (e.g., RNA-Seq), repository name and recommended acronym, accession/DOI, and a resolvable link.
